text:
anna: Quick accessibility pass from the design review: table keyboard nav is inconsistent after toggling the row-details drawer. Repro: Console > Projects > Table, Tab to a row, press Enter to open drawer, then Tab/Arrow — sometimes focus jumps to header actions.

li: I can repro on macOS VoiceOver. The focus ring is present initially but disappears when the drawer animates in. SR sometimes reads the table header instead of the drawer heading.

devon: same on NVDA. Root cause seems to be that we replace the row node when the drawer mounts (virtualized list). Our roving tabindex gets lost.

anna: propose: keep a single tabbable container (role=listbox) and use aria-activedescendant or move focus into the drawer only after it finishes opening. Also add a polite live region announce like 'Details opened for project Alpha'.

li: +1. Note about VoiceOver: aria-activedescendant works but VoiceOver may not expose children as expected. If we programmatically focus the first control inside the drawer, add a short timeout for animations or check prefers-reduced-motion.

devon: CSS nit: current focus uses 1px shadow which is invisible on the lightest themes. Let's make it a 2px solid outline fallback: `.focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--a11y-focus, #0366d6); outline-offset: 3px; }`

patrick: also add aria-label on the drawer region and role=document or region with `aria-labelledby` referencing a stable id. Avoid ephemeral ids generated during virtualization. Use `data-row-id` to derive stable ids.

a11y-bot: a11y-scan: keyboard-navigation FAIL. Recommended checks: focus-retention, SR announcement, reduced-motion timing. See /logs/a11y/1751234567-table-drawer.log

anna: plan: devon will prototype swapping roving tabindex -> stable container + aria-activedescendant behind FF. We'll add a live region announce and a reduced-motion guard. Devon, can you open a draft PR and add test cases?

devon: will do. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4901 (WIP) includes a11y notes, a demo page for dogfood, and test scenarios for VoiceOver + NVDA.

li: when PR is up, please tag design for copy review of the announce text. Short and consistent helps SR users. Suggest: 'Details opened for project {name}'.

anna: thanks everyone. We'll run a small canary with engineers who use SR. :thumbsup:
